name: Real-Time Volumetric Shadows using 1D Min-Max Mipmaps
definition: A real-time algorithm for computing volumetric shadows in single-scattering media on the GPU. It computes the scattering integral over intersections of camera rays with a shadow map treated as a 2D height field, using epipolar rectification to reduce the problem to 1D height fields and a 1D min-max mipmap acceleration structure to find lit segments in parallel.
summary: This GPU method computes real-time volumetric shadows by using epipolar rectification and 1D min-max mipmaps to find lit segments in parallel, avoiding GPGPU APIs.
